_repin_note: Re-based from the bigram-categorical stand-in to the canonical nanoGPT decoder. Every value above is read from environment/nanogpt_substrate.json, which is read in turn from the vendored record set at harness/records/track_3_optimization/train_gpt_simple.py. Nothing here is invented.
_vocab_note: vocab_size 50304 is the frozen embedding and output-projection width. It is the ceiling on the submitted vocabulary, not a target: a submission may ship fewer entries and the unused rows stay allocated, so the parameter count does not move with the vocabulary and the compute per step is identical across submissions.
_note: The model is frozen. Its shape is fingerprinted at run open and again at run close against the declared vocab_size, num_layers, model_dim and head_dim, and a run whose fingerprint moves is refused with reason frozen-axis-mutated.
